userdoc.notice: Stateless lifecycle hook admitting any orchestrator registered in OrchestratorRegistry and enforcing deposit-scoped whitelist policies. A taker is admitted when enforcement is disabled for the intent's deposit or when the policy allows the taker through that deposit's direct whitelist or one of its allowed groups. Settlement and cancellation are no-ops in this version.
